etymologies.etymologyHTML: From enrich +‎ -ment.

definitions.definition: The act of enriching or something enriched.
The process of making enriched uranium.
The addition of sugar to grape juice used to make wine; chaptalization.
Stimulation provided for the mental wellbeing of a captive animal.

quote.citation: 2009, Marc Bekoff, Encyclopedia of Animal Rights and Animal Welfare, 2nd Edition, page 208:
quote.text: The practice of enrichment to address these problems started in zoos and later spread to more intensively managed captive settings, such as farming and animal laboratories.
